cma-child-with-drum.title: Child with Drum
cma-child-with-drum.creator: Unidentified photographer
cma-child-with-drum.alt: A very old photo of a child holding a drum and two drumsticks.
cma-child-with-drum.credit: Child with Drum, 1850s. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-two-children-with-toys.title: Two Children with Toys
cma-two-children-with-toys.creator: Unidentified photographer
cma-two-children-with-toys.alt: A very old photo of two children. A doll sits in a wooden cart with wheels. There is a basket on the floor.
cma-two-children-with-toys.credit: Two Children with Toys, about 1855. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

elizabeth-i-armada-portrait.title: The Armada Portrait of Elizabeth I
elizabeth-i-armada-portrait.creator: Unknown English artist
elizabeth-i-armada-portrait.alt: A painting of Queen Elizabeth I. She wears a huge lace ruff, pearls and a big jewelled dress. Her hand rests on a globe. Ships are painted behind her.
elizabeth-i-armada-portrait.credit: The Armada Portrait of Elizabeth I, about 1588. Public domain.

loc-blackpool-beach.title: The tower with beach, Blackpool
loc-blackpool-beach.creator: Photochrom Print Collection
loc-blackpool-beach.institution: Library of Congress, via Wikimedia Commons
loc-blackpool-beach.alt: An old coloured photo of a crowded beach at Blackpool. A tall tower and a long pier stand by the sea. People wear long coats and hats.
loc-blackpool-beach.credit: Blackpool beach, 1890s. Photochrom print, Library of Congress, public domain.

loc-shakespeares-birthplace.title: Shakespeare's birthplace, Stratford-on-Avon
loc-shakespeares-birthplace.creator: Photochrom Print Collection
loc-shakespeares-birthplace.institution: Library of Congress, via Wikimedia Commons
loc-shakespeares-birthplace.alt: An old coloured photo of a very old house. It has a wooden frame, white walls, small windows and a steep roof.
loc-shakespeares-birthplace.credit: Shakespeare's birthplace, Stratford-upon-Avon, 1890s. Library of Congress, public domain.

loc-wright-first-flight.title: First flight
loc-wright-first-flight.creator: John T. Daniels
loc-wright-first-flight.institution: Library of Congress, via Wikimedia Commons
loc-wright-first-flight.alt: A very old black-and-white photo. A plane with long flat wings flies just above the sand. A man runs beside it.
loc-wright-first-flight.credit: The first flight, 1903. Photo by John T. Daniels. Library of Congress, public domain.

nasa-apollo-11-bootprint.title: A bootprint on the Moon
nasa-apollo-11-bootprint.creator: NASA / Buzz Aldrin
nasa-apollo-11-bootprint.alt: A photo of a bootprint in grey dust on the Moon.
nasa-apollo-11-bootprint.credit: A bootprint on the Moon, Apollo 11, 1969. NASA, public domain.

nasa-apollo-11-launch.title: Apollo 11 launch
nasa-apollo-11-launch.creator: NASA
nasa-apollo-11-launch.alt: A photo of a tall white rocket taking off. Fire and smoke pour out at the bottom.

nasa-neil-armstrong.title: Neil Armstrong
nasa-neil-armstrong.creator: NASA
nasa-neil-armstrong.alt: A photo of Neil Armstrong in a white space suit. He holds his helmet. A picture of the Moon is behind him.

queen-victoria-bassano-1882.title: Queen Victoria
queen-victoria-bassano-1882.creator: Alexander Bassano
queen-victoria-bassano-1882.alt: A black-and-white photo of Queen Victoria. She wears a small crown, a long white veil and a necklace.
queen-victoria-bassano-1882.credit: Queen Victoria, 1882. Photo by Alexander Bassano. Public domain.

mary-seacole-photo.title: Mary Seacole
mary-seacole-photo.creator: Maull & Company
mary-seacole-photo.alt: A black-and-white photo of Mary Seacole wearing a hat, a dark dress and medals.
mary-seacole-photo.credit: Mary Seacole, about 1873. Maull & Company. Public domain.

edith-cavell-portrait.title: Edith Cavell
edith-cavell-portrait.creator: Bain News Service
edith-cavell-portrait.alt: A black-and-white portrait photo of Edith Cavell wearing a white blouse and a high lace collar. Her name is written above the oval portrait.
edith-cavell-portrait.credit: Edith Cavell, before 1915. Bain News Service. Public domain.

emily-davison-portrait.title: Emily Wilding Davison
emily-davison-portrait.creator: Andrew William Dron
emily-davison-portrait.alt: A black-and-white portrait photo of Emily Davison wearing a dark jacket.
emily-davison-portrait.credit: Emily Wilding Davison, before 1913. Andrew William Dron. Public domain.

great-fire-london-painting.title: The Great Fire of London
great-fire-london-painting.creator: Unknown artist
great-fire-london-painting.alt: An old painting of the Great Fire of London. Flames rise above buildings beside the river. Boats are on the water.
great-fire-london-painting.credit: The Great Fire of London, about 1675. Unknown artist. Public domain.

florence-nightingale-portrait.title: Florence Nightingale
florence-nightingale-portrait.creator: Henry Hering
florence-nightingale-portrait.alt: An old black-and-white portrait photo of Florence Nightingale in a dark dress.
florence-nightingale-portrait.credit: Florence Nightingale, about 1860. Henry Hering. Public domain.

cma-flint-handaxe.title: Hand Axe
cma-flint-handaxe.creator: Unknown maker
cma-flint-handaxe.alt: A photo of a dark flint hand axe from Egypt. Its uneven surface has chipped patches and worked edges. It has no handle or writing.
cma-flint-handaxe.credit: Flint hand axe from Egypt, about 120,000–30,000 BC. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-bronze-axe.title: Axe Head
cma-bronze-axe.creator: Unknown maker
cma-bronze-axe.alt: A photo of a bronze axe head from the Caucasus. Fine lines and an animal design decorate its surface. Its handle is missing.
cma-bronze-axe.credit: Axe Head, 900–600 BC. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-claudius-coin.title: Aureus: Bust of Claudius I (obverse)
cma-claudius-coin.creator: Unknown maker
cma-claudius-coin.alt: A gold Roman coin showing Claudius from the side. Letters run around his head.
cma-claudius-coin.credit: Aureus: Bust of Claudius I (obverse), 47–48 AD. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-verica-coin.title: Verica Stater: Sunken Tablet (obverse); Horse and Rider (reverse)
cma-verica-coin.creator: Unknown maker
cma-verica-coin.alt: Two sides of a British gold coin of King Verica. One side shows a horse and rider. The other has letters in a sunken rectangle.
cma-verica-coin.credit: Verica Stater: Sunken Tablet (obverse); Horse and Rider (reverse), about 10–40 AD. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-roman-mosaic.title: Mosaic Pavement
cma-roman-mosaic.creator: Unknown maker
cma-roman-mosaic.alt: A Roman floor mosaic from Italy. Small light and dark stone pieces form repeating patterns, borders and shapes.
cma-roman-mosaic.credit: Mosaic Pavement, 1–100 AD. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-egypt-boat-jar.title: Decorated Jar with Boat Scenes
cma-egypt-boat-jar.creator: Unknown maker
cma-egypt-boat-jar.alt: An ancient Egyptian pottery jar with a round body and an opening. Painted boat shapes and rows of short lines decorate its surface.
cma-egypt-boat-jar.credit: Decorated Jar with Boat Scenes, about 3300–3100 BC. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-egypt-coffin-lid.title: Coffin of Bakenmut (lid)
cma-egypt-coffin-lid.creator: Unknown maker
cma-egypt-coffin-lid.alt: A painted wooden Egyptian coffin lid for Bakenmut, not an uncovered body. A face, striped head covering, writing and many figures decorate it.
cma-egypt-coffin-lid.credit: Coffin of Bakenmut (lid), about 1000–900 BC. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-egypt-scribe.title: Seated Scribe of Medthu
cma-egypt-scribe.creator: Unknown maker
cma-egypt-scribe.alt: An Egyptian stone statue of a seated scribe. A writing surface rests across his lap.
cma-egypt-scribe.credit: Seated Scribe of Medthu, about 1479–1425 BC. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-egypt-papyrus.title: Book of the Dead of Hori
cma-egypt-papyrus.creator: Unknown maker
cma-egypt-papyrus.alt: An Egyptian papyrus, the Book of the Dead of Hori. Rows of small writing signs and drawn figures fill the long sheet.
cma-egypt-papyrus.credit: Book of the Dead of Hori, about 1069–945 BC. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-egypt-fishing.title: Spearing Fish
cma-egypt-fishing.creator: Unknown maker
cma-egypt-fishing.alt: An Egyptian stone carving of fish among tall plants, with a spear passing across them. Traces of colour remain.
cma-egypt-fishing.credit: Spearing Fish, about 667–647 BC. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-roman-altar.title: Circular Altar with Hermes and Pallas Athena
cma-roman-altar.creator: Unknown maker
cma-roman-altar.alt: A Roman marble altar with carved figures of Hermes and Athena. One figure wears a helmet and holds a long spear.
cma-roman-altar.credit: Circular Altar with Hermes and Pallas Athena, 100 BC–100 AD. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

cma-egypt-king.title: Head of a King
cma-egypt-king.creator: Unknown maker
cma-egypt-king.alt: An Egyptian stone sculpture of a king wearing a striped headcloth with a snake shape at the forehead. The king is not securely identified.
cma-egypt-king.credit: Head of a King, about 1069–715 BC. Cleveland Museum of Art, CC0.

burton-tutankhamun-tomb.title: Objects in Tutankhamun's tomb
burton-tutankhamun-tomb.creator: Harry Burton
burton-tutankhamun-tomb.institution: Heidelberg University Library, via Wikimedia Commons
burton-tutankhamun-tomb.alt: Harry Burton's black-and-white 1922 photograph of furniture and disassembled chariot parts in Tutankhamun's tomb.
burton-tutankhamun-tomb.credit: Objects in Tutankhamun's tomb, 1922. Photo by Harry Burton. Public domain.

skara-brae-houses.title: Stone house at Skara Brae
skara-brae-houses.creator: Libasstref
skara-brae-houses.alt: A modern photo of a ruined stone house at Skara Brae. Low stone walls, stone furniture and a square central hearth survive. The original roof is missing.
skara-brae-houses.credit: Stone house at Skara Brae. Photo by Libasstref, CC0.

stonehenge-stones.title: Stonehenge
stonehenge-stones.creator: Erwin Bosman
stonehenge-stones.alt: A modern photo of Stonehenge. Some stones stand upright with others across their tops. Some have fallen or are missing.
stonehenge-stones.credit: Stonehenge. Photo by Erwin Bosman, CC0.

hadrian-walltown.title: Hadrian's Wall at Walltown Crags
hadrian-walltown.creator: Marco Prins
hadrian-walltown.alt: A modern photo of Hadrian's Wall at Walltown Crags. Rows of stone blocks follow uneven ground.
hadrian-walltown.credit: Hadrian's Wall at Walltown Crags. Photo by Marco Prins, CC0.

maiden-castle-banks.title: Maiden Castle from above
maiden-castle-banks.creator: Jo and Sue Crane
maiden-castle-banks.alt: An aerial photo of Maiden Castle in Dorset. Curving earth banks and ditches surround a large enclosure, with modern fields outside it.
maiden-castle-banks.credit: Maiden Castle from above. Photo by Jo and Sue Crane, CC0.
